content: Aluminium acetotartrate, also known as ALSOL, is an organic compound that functions as an astringent and disinfectant. It is the aluminium salt derived from acetic acid and tartaric acid. This compound appears as colorless or slightly yellowish crystals. It is freely soluble in water, although the dissolution process is exceedingly slow, and it is insoluble in alcohol and ether. In medical applications, a 5–2% solution of aluminium acetotartrate is used as a nasal douche for conditions affecting the respiratory tract. A 1–3% solution can serve as a substitute for aluminium acetate solution. Concentrated solutions are applied as a lotion for treating frostbite and balanitis. Additionally, it is used as a snuff combined with boric acid for managing atrophic rhinitis. Aluminium acetotartrate is also utilized in the formulation of antiseptic ointments and creams for wound care.
